import java.util.Scanner;

public class ProblemE {
    public static long M = 998244353L;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        long m = in.nextLong();
        long n = in.nextLong();
        long l = in.nextLong();
        long r = in.nextLong();

            if (num % 2 == 0) {
                System.out.println((a * inv2) % M);
            } else {
                System.out.println(((a + 1) % M * inv2) % M);
            }
        }
    }

    public static long exp(long a, long b) {
        return exp0(a, b, new ArrayList<Long>());
    }

    private static long exp0(long a, long b, List<Long> pending) {
        if (b == 0) {
            return applyPending(pending, 1);
        }
        if (b == 1) {
            return applyPending(pending, a);
        }
        if ((b & 1L) != 0L) {
            pending.add(a);
        }
        return exp0((a * a) % M, b / 2, pending);
    }

    private static long applyPending(List<Long> pending, long ans) {
        for (int i = pending.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            ans = (ans * pending.get(i)) % M;
        }
        return ans;
    }
}
